lanes.label: Lane A · Survival (Step 1, fresh cycle)
lanes.whyLadderPick: The two highest-probability draw-protected legs on the slate, from different same-day games — Spain or Draw (77%) and Belgium or Draw (66%). Double chance is the settled 8-0 market family: each leg survives a draw and only loses on an outright underdog win. Built to CLEAR a rung, not to swing for a payout.
lanes.whyItCouldFail: Both legs must land: an outright Portugal win over Spain, or an outright USA win over Belgium, drops the card. Double chance survives a draw but never an underdog win — and knockout games carry extra-time variance on the 90-minute result.
